text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To explain why I entrusted my dream to
Chiyo, I'd
have to rewind way back in
time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's a period of my racing career I
can't
remember clearly—like there's a
blurry smudge
over the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I remember everything until January of
that year.
I had finally entered the
racing world I'd loved
since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had rivals to race against, and I even
managed
to win the Best Junior
Umamusume award. Every
day was a
blast.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It was like a dream, being able to run
every day. I
was so excited to race with
more and more
people.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But then, one after another, the people I
wanted
to race with started turning me
down, until one
day...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. Whenever I run with you, it feels
like my
own future gets dimmer...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She hung her head and told me about
her dream.
She wanted to win a graded
race and make her
mother proud.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: She swore she'd do anything to make that dream come true... and then she asked me what dream I was running for.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't understand how she felt at all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have a dream. I just liked to race.
I simply
wanted to compete with
everyone and run like
the wind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard what the people in the crowd
would say.
That I could be the Derby
champion, or that I
might even win a
Grand Prix race.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But what then? I couldn't think of
anything I'd
gain from continuing down
that track. I'd just
keep losing the
precious things I'd once had.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And that was when I heard the sound of

something breaking inside of me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a lot of memories after that.
I can't
even remember why I decided to
abandon the
Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But time went on, I gained new friends,
and I
started enjoying life again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Except... whenever someone brought up
the
Derby, I felt that fuzziness in my
memory get just
a bit bigger.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Regret dug deeper into my heart. What if I had gone on to the Derby? What would it've been like, running there?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
By the time I realized it, winning the
Derby had
become something of an
unfulfilled dream for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I met someone who said she wanted to
be like me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes didn't just sparkle with
admiration—they
glowed with
determination. The second I met her

gaze, I felt something like fate.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I wanted her to become like me too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo. Go get the Derby in my stead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it looks like your dear admirer will
be running
here today.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, isn't she the cutest? ♪ You can
spot her
adorableness even from a
million miles away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Chiyo... Carry on my spirit with all
you've
got... and have fun out there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Are you certain you want to give her
everything?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've already given her my dream
and
everything I am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch Sakura Chiyono O enter the
paddock,
her expression suddenly
changes into one of
shock, but she
quickly composes herself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win the Derby today. For
your sake,
too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: All three of us have made it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I managed to recover in time. Ready
to face
you both in this singular moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to run forever. But that is
the very
reason why I run today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've been preparing for so long, all to
make this
moment count... Here and
now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Here and now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same. I'm so glad this is the
Derby I get
to race in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My rivalry with you two is what pushed
me to
persevere and keep honing
myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose to you two, and I

wholeheartedly want to become
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to prove that I've surpassed
you
both, and that my desire to win is
stronger than
anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you just how strong the dream
Maruzen
shared with me is.
